turns.question: By what percentage did revenue in the week starting Monday 14 September 2026 grow over the week before?
turns.answer: Revenue grew 32.7% (a 0.33 share of the prior week's revenue) in the week of 14-20 September 2026 over the week before. Freshness: Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
